2607.17147.title: SlotGuard: Stop Oversharing Private Local Context in LLM Agent Transcri
2607.17147.paper_summary: LLM agents can leak privacy (e.g., paths, emails) and credentials (e.g., API keys) as agent observations (e.g., tool outputs, shell logs, and file reads) are appended to provider-bound transcripts. Existing placeholder redaction is brittle: it can miss embedded or cross-turn references, over-redact benign lookalikes, and destroy the structure useful for reasoning. We present SlotGuard, a local transcript boundary that can hide sensitive data while retaining agents' performance. SlotGuard rewrites structural bindings as typed, suffix-aware slots, replaces secrets with format-preserving synthetic values, links cross-turn references with a lightweight session graph, and restores raw values only inside the trusted runtime. On controlled repository-oriented agent transcripts, SlotGuard removes all 20,814 annotated structurally sensitive characters across 9,229 paths and reduces credential leakage to 0.0\% across 852 planted values. It remains close to raw-transcript task success across four upstream models, while generic redaction drops to 2.5\%. Transcript rewriting takes a median of 14.424~$μ$s per agent turn. The code is publicly accessible at https://github.com/illinoisdata/SlotGuard.
2607.17147.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理可能會洩漏隱私（例如，路徑、電子郵件）和憑證（例如，API 金鑰），因為代理觀察（例如，工具輸出、Shell 日誌和文件讀取）會附加到供應商綁定的記錄中。現有的佔位符刪除方法脆弱：它可能會錯過嵌入或跨回合的引用，過度刪除無害的相似項，並破壞有助於推理的結構。我們提出了 SlotGuard，一種本地記錄邊界，可以在保持代理性能的同時隱藏敏感數據。SlotGuard 將結構綁定重寫為類型化的、後綴感知的插槽，將秘密替換為格式保留的合成值，通過輕量級會話圖鏈接跨回合引用，並僅在受信任的運行時內恢復原始值。在受控的以庫為導向的代理記錄中，SlotGuard 移除了 9,229 梯路中的所有 20,814 個標註的結構敏感字符，並將憑證洩漏降低至 0.0\%，共計 852 個植入值。在四個上游模型中，它的任務成功率接近原始記錄，而通用刪除則降至 2.5\%。記錄重寫每個代理回合的中位數為 14.424~$μ$s。代碼可在 https://github.com/illinoisdata/SlotGuard 公開訪問。
